_comment: From the Emenla claims policy. `npm run check` fails the build if any of these appear in rendered copy, outside the sentences listed in allowed_sentences (refusals and required educational context). Terms are matched on word boundaries, case-insensitive, so 'treatment' does not match 'treat' but 'treats' would need its own entry.
allowed_sentences: Tell you whether you have endometriosis. It never will.
Predict your next period or your next flare.
Talk about a root cause or a cure. There is no cure for endometriosis, and Emenla will not pretend otherwise.
Emenla is not a medical device, does not provide medical advice, and does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any condition.
Does Emenla tell me whether I have endometriosis? No, and it never will.
Does Emenla predict my period or my flares? No.
Nothing in Emenla is a prediction.
